statement: At fixed viscosity and energy upper bound, a uniform pointwise enstrophy-production bound C(1+E^alpha) with alpha<3 is impossible on smooth mean-zero periodic initial data.
hypotheses: Unforced 3D periodic Navier-Stokes; smooth solenoidal initial fields; fixed nu>0 and energy upper bound M>0.
definitions: E=integral |curl u|^2, D=integral |grad curl u|^2, S=integral omega dot (omega dot grad)u.
source_locators: NS-001/002/003 and Lu & Doering (2008), https://iumj.org/article/4718/; Clay announcement https://www.claymath.org/news/navier-stokes-announcement/.
proof_or_gap: Localize a periodic positive-stretching seed by curl of a cut-off periodic vector potential; positive bulk dominates the surface layer. Choose fixed amplitude to dominate viscosity and concentrate by critical scaling. Energy decays as lambda^-1, E grows as lambda, initial E' as lambda^3. A subcubic bound fails.
implication_to_claim: Eliminates a proposed scalar instantaneous route to NS.critical_bound; does not prove or disprove global continuation. A conditional high-strain L^(3/2) tail estimate provides a next precise target.
unproved_dependencies: Uniform time-integrable amplitude threshold with small high-strain tail for every smooth evolution; continuation estimate under full official hypotheses.
adversarial_findings: Concentration breaks any subcubic bound even with a uniform kinetic-energy upper bound. No dynamic blowup inferred. Prior art on cubic sharpness exists.
